articles.summary: SEC registration enables Cboe Clear U.S. to clear binary securities options alongside futures, positioning it to support innovation across the market Cboe Global Markets, Inc. (Cboe: CBOE), a leading global markets operator and pioneer in equity and index derivatives, today announced that Cboe Clear U.S., LLC (CCUS) has received temporary registration from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to operate as a Covered Clearing Agency. The registration expands CCUS's clearing capabilities beyond its existing authorities as a Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC)-registered Derivatives Clearing Organization (DCO) to clear securities products in addition to futures and swaps products. Together with recent enhancements to its regulatory framework and product scope, the milestone positions CCUS to support innovation and emerging opportunities across a broad range of assets and markets. CCUS will initially use its SEC registration to clear Cboe's binary securities options
articles.title: Cboe Clear U.S. Receives SEC Approval to Expand Clearing Capabilities

articles.summary: Increases share repurchase authorization by $550 million Quarterly cash dividend of $0.86 per share Cboe Global Markets, Inc. (Cboe: CBOE), a leading global markets operator and pioneer in equity and index derivatives, today announced its Board of Directors has authorized the company to repurchase up to an additional $550 million of its outstanding common stock and declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.86 per share of common stock for the fourth quarter of 2026. The fourth-quarter 2026 dividend is payable on December 15, 2026, to stockholders of record as of November 30, 2026. As of June 30, 2026, the Company had $536.8 million of availability remaining under its existing share repurchase authorizations.
